detailText:
SU
Connect Supabase

Enter the project URL and a publishable/anon API key. VibeSpace rejects privileged service-role or secret keys before calling the REST root.

WHAT THIS PLUGIN DOES

Database, authentication, storage, edge functions, and project API context.

Provider: Supabase · Auth: api key

Authorization capability: manual fallback

Official provider account page

Sign in or create your Supabase account on the provider-owned page. Keep this panel open to finish the supported credential fallback.

Open Supabase account page

SETUP STEPS

Open your Supabase project → Settings → API.
Copy the project URL and publishable/anon key.
Paste both values and test.

Secure credential storage

Values saved here go to the OS keychain on desktop (session-only memory in browser preview). VibeSpace does not print them in logs or terminal context.

Project URL
Project API key

Use a publishable/anon key for read-only context. Service-role and secret keys are rejected.
